julesThoughtProcess: Selected a golden yellow (#FFD700) to represent the enduring warmth and resilience of the community in this technofuturistic world.
storyPanel: The neighborhood data-broker stand wasn't much to look at—just a holographic awning flickering against the smog. But old Mr. Henderson still sold hand-crafted logic cores alongside his digital apples. 'Algorithms are fine,' he'd say, polishing a glowing cube, 'but you can't code out the human touch.' A passing courier droid bleeped in agreement, pausing long enough to share a quick charge from its battery pack before rushing back into the bustling, neon-soaked streets.
